mapper.sql: id, parent_id, name, type, path, component, icon, perms, sort, visible, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE perms = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.perms, m.sort, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 AND m.type IN ('catalog', 'menu') ORDER BY m.sort, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, name, type, path, component, icon, perms, sort, visible, status) VALUES (COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), #{name}, #{type}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{code}, COALESCE(#{sort}, 0), COALESCE(#{visible}, 1), COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = COALESCE(#{parentId}, parent_id), name = #{name}, type = #{type}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, perms = #{code}, sort = COALESCE(#{sort}, sort), visible = COALESCE(#{visible}, visible), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status) WHERE id = #{id}
